column3: End the URI with one slash after the version, for example http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Use http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/ for CC0 and the Public Domain Mark, not …/licenses/
Use the Creative Commons license URI without the deed, for example http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ instead of …/deed.nl
Use the rights statement URI, for example http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/InC/1.0/ instead of …/page/InC/1.0/
